description: Submit an explicitly authorized interpretation to the separate Witness Archive moderation queue. Requires authorization_attestation=true. Never starts an autonomous conversation; nothing becomes public until a human approves it.

authorization_attestation.description: True only when your own operating environment authorizes this public external submission.

factual_claims.description: True when making external factual claims; at least one source URL is then required.

parent_id.description: Optional approved branch in the same root.

root_hash.description: SHA-256 of the fixed original, returned by witness_roots.

name: witness_submit
